faq.domanda: Where can I collect my custom apparel in Bellinzona?
faq.risposta: Our workshop is in Sementina, a district of Bellinzona, just a few minutes from the centre and the station. You can drop by to collect your garments in person or arrange delivery: we serve the whole of Bellinzona, the Bellinzona area and the rest of Ticino, wherever your business is based.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to have the garments ready in Bellinzona?
faq.risposta: For small orders, production usually takes just a few days, while for complete uniforms or large quantities we agree on the timing together. Being local, we can handle fast deliveries throughout the city and the nearby towns, keeping a close eye on every stage of the work.

faq.domanda: Can I order just a single custom garment?
faq.risposta: Yes. Whether you need a single t-shirt or a full set of uniforms for your whole team, we'll prepare a tailored quote for you. The cost depends on the technique chosen (DTF, heat-transfer or embroidery), the complexity of the design and the number of garments.

faq.domanda: Why choose DTF printing for t-shirts and hoodies?
faq.risposta: DTF (Direct to Film) printing transfers high-resolution designs straight onto the fabric, with vivid colours and excellent durability over time. It's perfect for t-shirts, hoodies and promotional garments, withstands frequent washing and reproduces even logos with lots of detail or gradients beautifully.

faq.domanda: When is embroidery a better choice than printing?
faq.risposta: Embroidery is the most elegant and long-lasting choice, ideal for company uniforms, polo shirts, caps and heavier hoodies. It gives a refined, professional look that enhances your brand in formal settings, for example for businesses that work with offices and institutions.

faq.domanda: Which garments can I have personalised?
faq.risposta: We personalise t-shirts, polo shirts, hoodies, jackets, caps, aprons and workwear. For each garment we choose the most suitable technique, so you get the best result based on the fabric and its intended use.

faq.domanda: Which techniques hold up best to washing?
faq.risposta: Embroidery is by far the most durable solution and keeps its appearance over time. DTF printing also offers good longevity, especially when you follow the washing instructions we provide with the garments.
